title: The 29 Published Joomla quickstarts keep their template-layer fixes: a profile row and demo names per new version, translated T4 header blocks in the Tracy templates, maps pinned to their own contract, Claude Cowork 0.24.21 pinned
steps: S1: For every contract in packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts whose manifest names coworkContractVersion 0.24.21 or 0.24.22 (JA Resort 1.0.4, #1248), read its template-profiles.json row and its <version>.copy.json.
S2: Read every file of template-patches/{tracy-base,tracy_business}/html/layouts/t4/{block,element} through the readiness reader hard-coded-words.js.
S3: For the same contracts, compare the baseHash of each demo-trim-map.json, multilingual-map.json and editions.json with the hash of its manifest, content map and presentation lock.
expect: S1: 30 contracts; each has a row for its version and at least one demoCompanyNames entry.
S2: no interface word written outside a translation.
S3: every map is pinned to its own contract's bytes.
S4: no 0.24.20 Joomla pin is left, and every pinned release pins 0.24.21 or later for its new version.
evidence: 12/10/2026: Template Customization Question Readiness on the 29 new packs, with #1239 merged in a check tree: 0 FAIL on 24, LANG-2 body-selector pairing on 5 (rule fix #1240); joomla-v0.24.21 carries the 29 contracts byte for byte; claude-cowork tests refused the first tracy-business 1.2.2 maps (stale baseHash)
fence: Contract data, template patches and pins in the tree, read with the readiness check's own reader; the script exits non-zero when any step finds a problem
